name: Monica Crowley
current_role: Chief of Protocol of the United States (since May 2025)
summary: Monica Crowley, a former Fox News commentator who was assistant secretary of the Treasury for public affairs in Trump’s first term, has been chief of protocol, with the rank of ambassador, since May 30, 2025, running state visits and diplomatic ceremony.
